ai.realism.bent_straight: {0} is a straight rolled {1} section drawn bent. Rolled profiles are not bent: split it into straight pieces, or mark it bent (bent=cold or bent=hot in the material text) with a radius the section allows.
ai.realism.bend_radius: {0} is bent to a radius of {1} mm; the section allows no less than {2} mm. Increase the radius, split it into straight pieces, or use hot bending.
ai.realism.axis_miss: The axis of {0} ends {2} mm from the axis of {1}. Axes meet at a node within 1 mm, or the eccentricity is declared with the ecc tag.
ai.realism.tiny_part: {0} is {1} mm thick; no part is thinner than 5 mm. Remove it or make it thicker.
ai.realism.sliver_gap: {0} and {1} are {2} mm apart. A gap under 1 mm is a sliver: make them touch or leave a real gap.
ai.realism.plate_thick: Plate {0} is {1} mm thick, more than 4 times the thinnest element it joins ({2} mm). Use a thinner plate.
ai.realism.bolt_dia: Bolt {0} has a diameter of {1} mm, which is not in the catalog series (M6 to M64).
ai.realism.bolt_hole: Bolt {0}: the hole is {1} mm for a {2} mm bolt. The hole is the diameter plus 0.5 to 3 mm.
ai.realism.bolt_edge: Bolt {0} is {1} mm from the plate edge; the minimum is {2} mm (1.2 hole diameters).
ai.realism.bolt_pitch: Bolt {0} is {1} mm from the next bolt; the minimum pitch is {2} mm (2.2 hole diameters).
ai.realism.cover: Rebar {0} has a cover of {1} mm; the minimum is {2} mm.
ai.realism.stirrup: Rebar {0}: stirrup spacing {1} mm is outside {2} to {3} mm.
ai.realism.stair_riser: Stair {0}: riser {1} mm is outside {2} to {3} mm.
ai.realism.stair_tread: Stair {0}: tread {1} mm is outside {2} to {3} mm.
ai.realism.floating: {0} (a group of {1} parts) hangs in the air: nothing carries it. Add a support or a connection down to the ground or a structure.
ai.realism.solid_glass: {0} is glass with a mean thickness of {1} mm ({2} m3 of glass). Glazing is a pane or a shell of 6 to 50 mm: use a panel or shell of a given thickness instead of a solid body.
ai.realism.filled_block: {0} is a filled block with a mean thickness of {1} m ({2} m3). A building body is made of walls, slabs and shells, not solid blocks: make it hollow or build it from slabs and walls.
ai.realism.part_size: {0} is {1} m long. A bare number is meters: check that millimeters were not given as meters.
ai.realism.outside_outline: {0} reaches {1} m past the walls and slabs of the building. Check its position and rotation.
ai.ref.attach_tip: Attach a picture or a PDF to compare the draft with
ai.settings.auto_snap: Look at the draft after each step
ai.settings.auto_snap_hint: Sends small 3D views of the draft to the model after each step. Costs tokens.
ai.settings.critic_hint: Finds bent straight profiles, missed nodes, floating parts and more, and asks the model to fix them (up to 3 rounds).
ai.settings.refine: Refine a new project's design before the draft
ai.settings.refine_hint: Fills the design fields the brief left open (facade system, canopy, trees) and rebuilds; the rule layout.refine_rounds sets the rounds, 0 or this box off drafts the brief as given.
